title: Give a person one project only
when: A person should work in one project and not see the others in the organization
need: An org owner or admin grants the project role, then removes the org role: on Team, Add project access with a project and role, then No org role in the Org role control; or yoke actors project-role set ACTOR-ID --project P --role ROLE, then yoke actors role remove ACTOR-ID. A person holds one role per project; a new one replaces it. The person then lists, reads and sees on Team only that project; other projects refuse with a permission error. Frontier, Sessions and Machines name no item, plan or claim from another project: an item waiting on hidden work reads Waiting on work in a project you cannot see. Owner protection and the last-owner rule refuse by name.
surface: Team Org role and Project access controls; actor CLI help.
gap: Production proof with a project-only person is pending YOK-5491's and YOK-5550's post-deploy QA.
review: Source tests cover set, replace, remove, named refusals, project visibility, roster filtering, Frontier and Sessions redaction, and the Team controls.
